# better-caprover-mcp

> An unofficial MCP server that lets any AI (such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, and others) deploy and manage apps on a self-hosted CapRover. It starts read-only, and deletes need a single-use confirmation token.

Limits are enforced in code, not in the prompt: modes (readonly, operate, admin), dry_run previews, secret redaction and a 5-minute single-use token for delete_app. 71 operations, no raw-request tool. No telemetry; the only network traffic goes to your CAPROVER_URL. Not supported yet: CapRover servers with two-factor auth.

## Docs

- [GitHub repository and README](https://github.com/guilhermebkel/better-caprover-mcp): install, configuration, tools, architecture
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/better-caprover-mcp): npx -y better-caprover-mcp
